_target: data/director/rally.json, Encounter's (the choreographer reads it while a rally runs)
_about: PARKED (Combat, 2026-10-25; docs/combat/pending/rally/README.md section 4). The choreographer's variety scoring for rally links (Game Design 23d item 13). It scores each candidate for the next link (the AI's choice, Simple's choice, and the planner's send candidates inside a rally) in the launch planner's points, on top of the planner's own terms. Fresh kinds and the world's links score highest, a repeat is pushed down hard, and the stick still wins.
ownKinds: ruled (23d item 17): each fighter's own link is its own kind; their ids are in combat/rally/<fighter>.json

variety._kind: a kind not among the rally's links so far scores kindNew; a kind used earlier in the rally but not as the last link kindEarlier; the same kind as the last link kindLast; a third of one kind is item 8's auto-tech, so it is never chosen (kindThird). It follows item 8's ladder of 4, 6 and 8 ticks (23d item 17)
variety._dest: the same rule for where the link sends him
variety._world: a world link (no press: the send carries him into the place) scores worldLink plus its place; the parted sea scores most, as 23d item 13 names it
variety._own: a fighter's own link shows who he is: a small lift, under the fresh-kind rule
variety.cantPay: a link whose ki he lacks is not a candidate

stick._note: a held stick keeps only the candidates inside its cone (the planner's TILT_CONE) and adds stickWins (200) to the stick's side: variety never overrides the player

personality: the planner's care term at the landing, as for every send: the hero away from people, a villain toward them
neutralStick: with no stick, the highest score is taken: spectacle by variety
display: internal: the points are never shown to a player, and they never read casualties (Legal RL-183)
flash: Legal mc04: the flash cap of 3 counted bursts a second holds across the whole rally; a link whose flash would pass it draws as dust, trail and ember instead

exclusions.rally.cyborg.wreck_toss: never a candidate when its predicted landing is near people, or with any civilian within 3 bh of the wreck, indoors or out (Legal RL-186)
